Control your TV without a Wi-Fi router
Your phone becomes the network. The TV connects to it, and TV Tools reaches the TV over the hotspot.
Tip: some TVs drop Wi-Fi when the hotspot uses 5 GHz only. Switch the hotspot to 2.4 GHz if the TV can\'t see it.
Devices advertise services like _googlecast._tcp or _adb-tls-connect._tcp. Android can only browse types it knows, so add a custom type if you\'re hunting something specific.

5555 for Fire TV & network ADB. For Android 11+ use the port shown in Wireless debugging. IPv6 addresses can include the port: [fe80::1]:5555.

Scheduled with WorkManager (24h, minimum periodic interval). Each run connects to your last TV over ADB, performs the task, then disconnects. Some TVs drop wireless debugging after a reboot — enable \'Wireless debugging\' again for jobs to resume. Wake-on-LAN works when the TV is off but still powered and reachable on the same network.
24-hour time, local to this phone. WorkManager runs it approximately on time (battery saver may delay it).
